prompts.body_south:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: a single transparent headless, armless RimWorld pawn BODY sprite.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, current version v10, which is slightly too broad through the waist. Image 2 is the older v9 proportion REFERENCE, which was too pinched. Produce exactly one edited body, retaining image 1's artwork.
Primary change: set the torso/waist contour HALFWAY BETWEEN these two versions. Gently narrow only image 1's lower-rib/waist region by roughly 6–7 percent, about half of the prior widening. It must visibly be narrower than image 1 but wider than image 2. Keep the transition smooth and softly fitted, no sharp corset notch.
Preserve the same shoulder span, collar/neck anchor, hip span, existing coat-tail extent and length, trouser/boot proportions, foot baseline, all clothing colors and recognizable buttons, buckles and lining. Hips must remain slightly wider than the whole shoulders including tiny shoulder caps. Do NOT widen shoulders, narrow hips or enlarge coat skirts. Keep every body part in place except the local waist contour and necessary small adjacent cloth-seam adjustment.
Style remains simple flat matte 2D game art, bold nearblack outer outline, sparse subordinate inner lines, muted plum/charcoal/blue-grey/ivory palette. No new gloss, gradients, detail, accessories or texture. No head, complete arms or hands. Same framing and total height. Real transparent background; no text, diagram, guide lines, checkerboard or shadow.
View: SOUTH true front. Preserve ivory tiered jabot, charcoal waistcoat, existing button count, blue-grey lapel edging and plum jacket. At native export scale the old v9 waist section was 49 px and v10 is 56 px; visually aim at about 52–53 px after identical normalization. These are proportional guidance, not requested image resolution. Reduce the waist itself, not the whole sprite width. Preserve image 1's lower body and hips.
